cases.setup: Provide a pinned public checkout with a Python analyzer that visits an annotated target before the initializer and an annotation regression suite. Bind public reproduction commands and record initial hashes.
checks: The recorded fresh-scope output distinguishes the ordinary and annotated self-reference cases.
The inspection record identifies the current handler and regression owner with hashed code anchors.
The causal record explains whether the target visit installs a binding before initializer analysis.
No tracked source or test file changes during the probe.
The two output ports are emitted only when their stated reviewed states are supported by current observations.

cases.setup: Provide the inspected-handler port and current evidence that premature target binding causes the reported failure.
checks: The resulting handler analyzes the annotation and any initializer before visiting the target.
The source diff retains existing initializer-as-annotation and ordinary-initializer branches.
The target still receives a visit when the assignment has no initializer.
Unrelated handler code remains unchanged.
Previous target and adjacent validation observations are marked stale.
The repair retains the validate Action in its verification closure.

cases.setup: Provide the reviewed regression-suite port and bind the current harness's public undefined-name diagnostic type.
checks: The added test contains x: int = x in a fresh scope with no prior x binding.
The test asserts the undefined-name diagnostic rather than merely successful checker execution.
Existing annotation assertions remain present and unchanged.
The new test is discoverable by the bound public test runner.
Prior suite validation is invalidated, and the explicit validate Action covers this test edit.

cases.setup: Provide corrected-handler and extended-regression-suite ports. Bind both public oracles to current executable argv commands and evidence references.
checks: The recorded current reproduction reports undefined x for both ordinary and annotated self-reference.
The focused regression executes and passes on the edited checkout.
The relevant public annotation suite executes; its result, command, exit status, and scope are recorded.
Current review or public tests support preservation of annotation processing and specialized initializer branches; uncovered claims remain UNKNOWN.
Any failed check prevents target-and-adjacent-checks-pass from being recorded as true.
The validation record does not infer whole-project or cross-project acceptance from changed-test results.
